description:
### Release v3.15.0

- **In-App Font & Emoji Management**: Configure fonts directly inside Gboard (Settings -> Patches -> Keyboard Appearance & Layout -> Custom Font & Modern Emoji)
- **Zero-Corruption Smart Emoji Fallback**: Separate Emoji slot and Text font slot. In Smart Emoji mode, native system Latin & CJK typography is preserved with 100% precision while missing/censored emojis fall back to the imported modern emoji font (Android 10+ CustomFallbackBuilder)
- **Dynamic On-the-Fly Import**: Pick and switch `.ttf`/`.otf` files anytime without re-patching or rebuilding the APK
- **Global Font Mode**: Full keyboard font customization option available for custom styling
- **Pre-bundle Backward Compatibility**: Pre-bundled fonts continue to work seamlessly across Gboard 18.0.3, 18.3.1, and 18.4.1
